note: Approved notification templates. Versioned data, not code, so wording can be reviewed without a deploy. Placeholders are substituted literally — there is no expression evaluation in the renderer.

templates.subject: {flight_number} to {destination_city} is delayed
templates.body:
Dear {passenger_name},

Your flight {flight_number} from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {scheduled_departure_local} is delayed by approximately {delay_minutes} minutes. The revised departure time is {revised_departure_local}.

We are sorry for the disruption. Our operations team is managing your itinerary and will contact you if anything changes.

Booking reference: {pnr}

This is an automated message from a demonstration system. No booking has been changed and no payment has been taken.

templates.subject: Action needed: your connection at {connection_airport}
templates.body:
Dear {passenger_name},

Your flight {flight_number} is now expected to arrive at {connection_airport} at {revised_arrival_local}. Your onward flight {onward_flight_number} is scheduled to depart at {onward_departure_local}, which no longer allows the minimum connection time of {minimum_connection_minutes} minutes.

Our operations team is reviewing alternatives for you. You do not need to do anything yet.

Booking reference: {pnr}

This is an automated message from a demonstration system. No booking has been changed and no payment has been taken.
